text:
A low-angle, slightly blurred view of a bench station. Top left: a white sign reading "Synthesis Workstation" with Chinese characters, bearing a purple-framed square fiducial (QR-like) marker. Behind it, two black vertical posts rise from the bench.

Right of centre: a black rack holding four clear tubes standing upright, each capped with an orange closure; the tubes appear empty. The rack sits on a grey extruded-aluminium frame with slotted profiles and a metal bracket.

Foreground: a brushed aluminium block with a white face carrying another black-and-white fiducial marker, plus several silver knurled bolt heads and fittings along its edges. Left foreground: white plastic plates and a white cylindrical post; another white cylindrical cap-like piece lies centre-right. Light background wall.
